title: Critters
review: It's like {Gremlins} meets {Alien}. {Lilo & Stitch} meets {Twin Peaks}? It's the best movie {Troll 2} could have ever hoped to be, had it not been a notorious failure. Critters is an admirable attempt at doing Spielberg, and building an interesting community of monster victims. Because there are multiple, finite antagonists, the humans get a have a few wins, to show you there's a chance. The get blown up like water balloons an regular intervals so it doesn't feel like an impossible challenge. I thought it was great fun.
spoilers: It's so funny that the Krites blow up the house for no reason, and they gleefully show you the huge fireball obliterating a real building. (It's not a model.) Even better: the rebuilding of the house was added after focus group testing the ending, and so they had to build a model anyway, implode it, and reverse the footage. A CGI explosion wouldn't have been funny at all.
